actions.name: assign-maker

payload.name: maker
payload.type: string Maker.id (required: the button is disabled until one is picked)

payload.name: reason
payload.type: string (trimmed, 4 or more characters; the Confirm dialog disables the button below 4, the seam throws 'failed')

actions.note: label 'Assign a maker' (no maker) or 'Change the maker'; offered unless state==='delivered'. One maker per order. Refused (not_allowed) when the maker is unchanged or the order is delivered; not_found for an unknown order or maker. Appends an Event 'Maker assigned: <name>' or 'Maker changed: <old> to <new>' with by and reason; audit log.
actions.evidence: POST /v1/admin/concierge/orders/:id/maker { maker, reason } -> OrderRow. One maker per order. Written to the audit log.
